description: GEOS BI is a powerful custom visual for Power BI, designed to bring advanced geospatial mapping capabilities directly into your dashboards. With support for large datasets, custom layers, and interactive tools like zooming and filtering, GEOS BI makes it easy to visualize location-based data for industries such as logistics, retail, and real estate. Key Features Flexible Geometry Support: Visualize points, lines, polygons, and complex geometries using standard formats like GeoJSON and WKT. Third-Party Layer Integration: Seamlessly add external map layers via WMS, with plans to support ArcGIS Image Service and OGC API - Features. Data-Driven Styling: Customize map appearance based on your data, including dynamic sizing and coloring. Efficient Point Clustering: Handle large point datasets with built-in clustering for improved performance and readability. Customizable Map & Style Settings: Choose from multiple background styles, adjust initial map location, and fine-tune visual controls and data appearance. Privacy First: All processing happens locally - no data is collected, stored, or transmitted externally. For guides, troubleshooting, and support, visit geosbi.com/docs. If you work with geospatial data in Power BI and need more flexibility and control, GEOS BI is built for you.
